signupPage.title: Create your account
signupPage.description: Sign up to create a workspace or join one you were invited to.

loginPage.title: Sign in
loginPage.description: Welcome back. Sign in to your account.
loginPage.twoFactorDescription: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

forgotPasswordPage.title: Forgot password?
forgotPasswordPage.description: Enter your email and we’ll send you a link to reset it.

resetPasswordPage.title: Reset your password
resetPasswordPage.description: Choose a new password for your account.

sessionsCard.title: Sessions
sessionsCard.description: Every device currently signed in to your account.
sessionsCard.signOutAll: Sign out of all other devices
sessionsCard.signOutDescription: It will need to sign in again to access your account.
sessionsCard.signOutAllTitle: Sign out of all other devices?
sessionsCard.signOutAllDescription: Every other device will need to sign in again. This device stays signed in.
sessionsCard.signedOutAll: Signed out of {count, plural, one{1 other device} other{# other devices}}.

twoFactorCard.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactorCard.description: Require a code from an authenticator app, in addition to your password, to sign in.
twoFactorCard.offExplanation: Add an extra step to signing in: a code from an authenticator app, in addition to your password.
twoFactorCard.recoveryCodesLeft: {count, plural, one{1 recovery code left} other{# recovery codes left}}
twoFactorCard.enrollDescription: Scan it with your authenticator app, or enter the secret manually, then confirm with a code.
twoFactorCard.manualSecret: Can’t scan it? Enter this secret manually
twoFactorCard.recoveryCodesDescription: Each code signs you in once if you lose access to your authenticator app. We show them only this once.
twoFactorCard.otherSessionsSignedOut: Every other signed-in device was signed out.
twoFactorCard.disableDescription: Confirm with your password and a current code to turn it off.
twoFactorCard.regenerateDescription: Confirm with your password and a current code. Your old recovery codes stop working.
